title: min-btc-node
description: A lightweight Bitcoin address tracker written in Rust — not a full node. It connects to the network to follow and correlate address activity, exercising raw TCP, binary serialization and concurrent peer handling without leaning on a library.

title: nixos-config
description: Declarative NixOS configurations and dotfiles that turn 'it works on my machine' into a versioned, rebuildable artifact — multi-host Infrastructure-as-Code for fully reproducible environments (also covers the self-hosted services formerly listed under a separate HomeLab entry).

title: pixel-war
description: A Web3 pixel-canvas project built as a course exercise — exploring on-chain ownership, ERC-721 minting and smart-contract security through a bidding model on pixels. Academic project, not deployed to production.
